name: Crushridge Warmongers
label: Quest
description: Marshal Redpath of Southshore wants the Crushridge ogres hit harder than before. You are sent into the Ruins of Alterac to find the Crushridge…
intro: Marshal Redpath of Southshore wants the Crushridge ogres hit harder than before. You are sent into the Ruins of Alterac to find the Crushridge Warmongers, so the brutes will stay away from the Alliance.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Now that you've had a taste of the Crushridge ogres, I want you to really bloody their noses...

Go into the Ruins of Alterac and seek out the Crushridge Warmongers. I want you to cut down a good number of them - that's the only way those brutes will learn to keep their distance from Alliance territory.

clips.title: Progress
paras: You have more Warmongers to slay, friend. You should be up on the mountains on your task, not down here with your weapon stowed.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Very good. Here is your reward.
And when you were hunting those Warmongers, how did Alterac city look? It's in bad shape I would guess. Ogres are not known for their cleanliness.
Thankfully, your efforts will help keep them away from Southshore.
